title: Coherent integer-labelled category
statement: For a small category C and an autoequivalence s, construct coherent integer powers whose functors are exactly the specified equivalence powers. They give a category on Object C with homs the disjoint union over n of Hom(X,s^n Y), normalized degree-zero identities and inclusion, and composition (n,f)(m,g)=(n+m,f followed by s^n(g) followed by powerComp(n,m)). No pullback or topology hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Apply the proved TensorInverse.intTensorFamily construction to the endofunctor s with its chosen inverse and unit/counit. Identify its objects with the specified equivalence powers by recursion, and transport the coherent family along that equality.

Use this family as an integer shift, and transport the existing integerActionCategory to the prescribed object copy by InducedCategory. Its hom equivalence is the required disjoint union. The shift zero comparison is the identity; ShiftedHom composition gives exactly the specified composition formula.

lean.statement:
theorem arrows_comp (X Y Z : C) (n m : ℤ)
    (f : X ⟶ (s ^ n).functor.obj Y) (g : Y ⟶ (s ^ m).functor.obj Z) :
    letI := category s
    arrows s X Z ((arrows s X Y).symm ⟨n, f⟩ ≫ (arrows s Y Z).symm ⟨m, g⟩) =
      ⟨n + m, f ≫ (s ^ n).functor.map g ≫ (powerComp s n m).hom.app Z⟩
